title: CLEAN input
description: EC-number prediction for one or more protein sequences.

input_fasta.description: Sequences to annotate. Each record is converted to a FASTA entry.

sequence.description: Amino-acid sequence. Used when it matches ^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]+$. Send an empty string when supplying DNA_sequence instead.

DNA_sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence, translated to protein when 'sequence' is empty or not a valid peptide.
